value.rationale: The stationary particle position is completely reconstructed as a natural two-state Gaussian thermal-variance mixture, overcoming nonexplicit general switching-diffusion tail theorems. The exact tail coefficient permits quantitative rare-displacement predictions; the equal-rate sequence of sharp diverging thermal moments and residues clarifies why stochastic stationarity is compatible with arbitrarily divergent physical fluctuations. This is an infinite-parameter phase diagram for a natural fluctuating stable/inverted trap rather than an arbitrary numerical slice.
